verdict.rationale: Insomnia supports mock servers (including AI-generated ones from a prompt/OpenAPI spec) and environment variables that can separate dev/staging/production configs, letting users test flows without hitting real production endpoints. However, there is no explicit 'sandbox environment' feature or documented guarantee of production-data isolation — it relies on users manually configuring mock servers/environments rather than a dedicated sandboxed testing mode. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/staging isolation feature, documentation guaranteeing no production data exposure, and independent evidence of AI agents using this for safe testing.
